Frequently asked questions

How many staff do I need for 12 toddlers in BC?
Group child care under 36 months runs 1:4 with a max group of 12 — so 12 toddlers require 3 qualified staff, including Infant/Toddler Educator certification requirements.
Do these ratios apply during nap time?
Licensing has specific provisions around supervision during sleep; reduced active staffing may be possible in limited circumstances, but confirm directly with your licensing officer before relying on it.
